_note: Titles for minted pieces whose token name is only the camera's filename (MAH04233, 00046). Each is taken from the piece's own transcript in transcripts/mints/: a phrase said on it, a name given, a place named. The filename is kept on the page as the file the token carries. A clip with under about a hundred words, or with words that name no subject, keeps its filename; a title for it would be a guess. 'from' is the line the title rests on. _onchain.py reads this.
